title: Harold's first drink and the segregated dance hall
summary: Harold describes his first drink after a dance hall in Missouri roped off white and colored sides; Harry says he drank little afterward.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Well, look, not all of that. Or Ram and Brown, or Sean, or George McCullough.
Oh, them tanks. Oh, everywhere. Tanks. The boys drink. I guess that's a good point to end with you and give Joe a chance. Yeah. He just tried to get managed, laid on, I made him manage.

You know the first drink I took? Uh-huh. In St. Joe, Missouri. In St. Joe, Missouri. When Sean dropped that wardrobe truck off his shoulder at the Booker Tee Hotel in St. Louis, Missouri. The first man moved in, a brand new hotel. He's gone up the stairs and dropped the truck on a man's display case. In a showcase.

You know what the man said? The man said, that's all right. He said, this is going to be your business when you come here. He just opened. He was so glad. There was ten men coming in there. Oh, yeah. You see?
Are you used to be used to this drink? That's right.

No. The first time I drank in my life, just to sound like a joke. We come from the planet that I was supposed to be the biggest dance hall. One of the biggest dance hall in the world. White and colored just danced that together. But when we went there, they put a rope in between. A rope? Just one rope. White on one side, colored one side. I mean, it was some confusion happened or a new man of town or something. I don't know. And I told Shy, I said, you can get drunk if you want. You're going to go to jail. I'm not taking care of you, man. Shy used to take care of him when he gets drunk. You know, keep him quiet. Bring him up in the room, put him to bed. And he called me a sissy. He said, you don't drink. I said, I bet you I could drink more than you. And Harry and Ram and Brown, that was to their glory. Harry will take a drink. I said, I'm going to drink more than him. And when he got drunk and couldn't stand up, I put him on my shoulder and the bottom of my shoulder and started to put him in bed. His first time in my life. First time in my life.

Uh-uh. No, I never drank too much after that. Now and then I drank a little chalk or a little swig, you know, something like. A little what? A chalk. What they call that? They sell about a gallon up there. They didn't sell much whiskey or brown. Armaha, what they sell that? They call it a chalk. Well, uh.
